title: Kelvara WM-500 front-load washer manual (fictional)

model_sticker.location: Inside the door rim, at the top.

model_code_format: WM-500 followed by a 4-character variant, for example WM-500-R4T9.

quick_checks.text: Is the door fully closed? The panel shows a lock icon when a cycle starts.
Is the drain hose behind the washer free of kinks?
Is the load too heavy or unbalanced?

causes: Pump motor failed, if E31 remains after cleaning the pump filter
error_codes.technician_reason: If E31 comes back after cleaning the pump filter, the pump needs replacing. Pump replacement is technician only.
If the door still will not lock after closing it firmly, the lock assembly needs replacing. That is technician only.

procedures.title: Clean the pump filter
procedures.verify: The washer should drain and spin with no error.

steps.text: Turn off the washer and unplug it.
If a hot wash just ran, wait 10 minutes. The water may be hot.

gate.prompt: Is the water cool to the touch?

steps.text: Open the small panel at the bottom front right.
Place the tray and towels under it. Pull out the small drain tube and let the water drain into the tray.
Twist the pump filter left and pull it out slowly.
Remove any lint, coins or hair, and rinse the filter.
Twist the filter back in until it is tight, then close the tube and the panel.
Plug the washer in and run the Drain & Spin cycle.

procedures.title: Close the door firmly
procedures.verify: The panel should show the lock icon and the error should be gone.

steps.text: Open the door, check nothing is caught in the rim, and close it firmly until it clicks.
